name: Clay Atkison
source:
MBTI: ENTP

"But yeah! Hope we can all be great friends and learn to trust each other... And I just wanna check to make sure, you're all aware of the fragility of your own mortality right now, yeah?"

The laidback playboy who, despite first impressions, enjoys entertaining others' thoughts on mortality. Jumping between being a lighthearted sycophant and a morbid debater, Clay is someone who can be hard to control. Claiming to have no understanding of why they might be here, Clay nonetheless greets everyone with a smile and a wink. Whether or not it's superficial, there's no denying Clay is looking for what makes the others tick.

[From [url=https://rainyholmes.itch.io/experiment-isolation]itch.io[/url]]
